summary: secondary.ts source chosenStat reads findCharacter(ctx.state, ctx.chosenTargetId); once the first hit kills the chosen enemy it has left the roster and the value is 0, so the second segment (enemyAboveTarget, already R012-anchored) deals 0 and emits nothing. Native Despond 8659: CountAttack@FromTarget at step 0 (counter captured before the kill) reused by Damage@FromTarget and Damage@AboveTarget. Needs chosenStat to fall back to castTracking.unitsAtCastStart (or an atCastStart flag) when the chosen unit is gone.
